items.title: 56679_Arthur Briggs oral history interview
items.q: cause he was with Billy Arnold's band

ctx.x: Well, Emile would always be at the "Flea Pit". He was the only guy of Billy Arnold's band, cause he was with Billy Arnold's band, that came around to see us, and stayed with us, and was with us.
Yes, Emile Christian was quite a man. He went back in 1940, I think.
